LORESTUDIO.enabled: Send to Lore Studio from this browser
LORESTUDIO.enabledHint: Turn this on in one GM browser only (for example the spectator view on the PC that runs Lore Studio).
LORESTUDIO.urlHint: Shown in Lore Studio under Settings → Foundry. Usually http://127.0.0.1:42012
LORESTUDIO.tokenHint: Copy it from Lore Studio under Settings → Foundry.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryFolderHint: Scenes in this scene folder (and its subfolders) count as scenery: they're fitted to 1920×1080, get weather, and show players just the picture.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryFitHint: Scenery scenes are sized to 1920×1080 with no grid, and their backgrounds fill the screen with the edges cropped. Your image files aren't changed.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryModeHint: On scenery scenes, players see just the picture: no scene controls or token HUD, and the view stays fitted to the screen.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryDayNight: Change backgrounds with the time of day
LORESTUDIO.sceneryDayNightHint: Name a scene's images like canyon_dawn.webp, canyon_day.webp, canyon_dusk.webp and canyon_night.webp, in the same folder, and set the scene to any one of them. Missing versions are skipped. Follows Calendaria's sunrise and sunset if it's installed.
LORESTUDIO.scenerySounds: Change sounds with the time of day
LORESTUDIO.scenerySoundsHint: Ambient sounds on the scene, and playlist sounds that are playing, switch between files named like forest_day.ogg and forest_night.ogg, the same way backgrounds do.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryFadeMsHint: How long the old background takes to fade into the new one. 0 switches instantly.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryWeatherHint: Calendaria's weather plays matching FXMaster effects on scenery scenes: rain, storms, snow, hail, fog, clouds, embers, and sandstorms with FXMaster+.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryWeatherEverywhereHint: Also play Calendaria's weather on battle maps and other scenes, not just scenery.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryWeatherStrengthHint: How strong the weather effects are, compared to FXMaster's defaults: lower is slower, lighter and more see-through. Clouds and fog slow down the most. 100 uses FXMaster's own settings.
LORESTUDIO.scenerySoundsMenuHint: Keep a list of your sounds (Rain, Forest, Wind...), then choose which one plays for each kind of weather and which one loops on each scene. They fade in and out for everyone.
